verdict.rationale: Veriff documents a Biometric Liveness solution that checks captured biometric data comes from a live person, available via API, web flow and native SDKs. Nothing in the pack shows the selfie being matched to the document portrait, or names defenses against specific presentation attacks. Missing for 10: documented selfie-to-document-portrait face matching, explicit defenses against printed photos, screen replays and replayed/injected video, technical depth on the liveness method, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
